lots.title: Planned, Preventative & Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services
lots.description: Measured Term Contract governed by JCT MTC 2024 for planned, preventative and responsive residential property maintenance and compliance services to individual properties within the London Borough of Bexley or surrounding areas. Scope includes repairs, void works and minor works; engineering repairs; and servicing and compliance works for gas and electrical installations. Initial Contract Term: 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2030 (4 years, no option to extend or price uplifts). Applies to approximately 230 Council-owned street properties, 120 private leased properties managed by the Council, and 3 Hostels (repairs and maintenance).
requirements: Contract governed by JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 (MTC 2024) and read in conjunction with Contract Particulars, Pricing Schedule / Schedule of Rates, this Specification and all associated Contract Documents.
General building maintenance: repairs, void works and minor works across ~230 Council-owned street properties, 120 private leased properties managed by the Council, and 3 Hostels.

Gas servicing and safety compliance to ensure compliance with current Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, including annual comprehensive service of every gas appliance and system to manufacturers' specifications.
Annual gas safety inspection and issue of Landlord's Gas Safety Record (CP12) for each dwelling, with monthly reporting to the Client Gas Contract Team.

Electrical testing and servicing to ensure compliance with IET Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) and Part P of the Building Regulations; provide Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICR) and electrical installation certificates on completion of new circuits.
Fire and Legionella compliance inspections and services to ensure compliance with all current and relevant regulations.
Fire alarms and Emergency Lighting inspection by a competent person in accordance with BS 5839 and the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005.
24-hour emergency out-of-hours service, with dedicated contact number (Monday-Friday 07:00-09:00 and 18:00-24:00; Saturday-Sunday 08:00-12:00).
Pest Control service in accordance with EN 16636 British and European quality standard for pest management services.
Rubbish clearance service with lawful disposal of waste at licensed tips; contractor must register as waste carrier or broker and retain Waste Disposal Certificates.

Asbestos reports and removal compliance: survey premises before works; do not use materials containing asbestos; removal performed only by specialist contractors appointed by the Council; comply with Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (CAR 2012) and HSE Guidance.
Orders: work instructed by Order issued electronically via a standard Works Approval Form; no work to commence until a valid Order has been issued; acknowledge orders promptly to the Council.

Response and completion times: Standard within 5 working days; Urgent same or next day, full completion within 1 working day; Emergency make safe within 4 hours, full completion ASAP; Small Void Works within 10 working days; Large Void Works within 28 working days.
Emergency follow-on works shall commence within 1 working day; any variation must be agreed in writing before commencement.

Payment: operate fully in accordance with the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 (as amended) and JCT MTC 2024 Section 4; monthly Application for Payment; monthly electronic invoices within one month of valuation period; 30-day final date for payment from receipt of valid invoice; invoices within six months of Order issue; VAT shown as separate line.
Participation in Bexley dynamic early-payment programme (Oxygen Finance) is optional.

Statutory compliance with Building Regulations 2010 (as amended), Building Safety Act 2022 and Part 2A, CDM Regulations 2015, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, BS 7671 IET Wiring Regulations, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, Environmental Protection Act 1990, and GDPR/Data Protection Act 2018.
Act as Principal Contractor under CDM 2015 where required, with no additional payment — allowance included in Pricing Schedule.
Health and safety: maintain SSIP-compliant registration (CHAS, EXOR Health and Safety, or OHSAS) for the duration of the contract; comply with Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

Asbestos handling: comply with CAR 2012 and HSE Guidance 2016; survey before commencement; cease work and notify Authorised Officer on discovery or suspected release; training on risks and recognition of ACMs.

Safety glazing compliance: Approved Document N of Building Regulations, Regulation 14 of Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992, BS 6206:1981, BS 952-1:1995 Parts 1 & 2 and BS 6262:2005 Part 4; replace non-compliant glazing.

Portable electrical equipment: voltage not greater than 110V, double insulated or effectively earthed; comply with Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 and Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998.
Hot works: provide safe working method statements and generic risk assessments; advise Authorised Officer; comply with Permit to Work; operatives suitably experienced and trained.
Working at height: comply with Working at Height Regulations 2005 and HSE guidance; provide method statements and risk assessments; comply with Council's scaffolding protocol.
Hazardous substances: written COSHH assessments available on premises; comply with Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (COSHH) 2002.
PPE: comply with Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 2002; eye protection to BS 7028:1999.
Accident reporting: comply with RIDDOR 2013; report to Authorised Officer and HSE as applicable.

Premises protocols: prior appointment only; proof of company/individual identity; treat clients (who may be vulnerable) with courtesy, confidentiality, no smoking, no use of client facilities without permission; do not leave a client without WC, cooker, heating or electricity at day's end.
All fixings must be appropriate size and type for the building fabric; second-hand materials or equipment are not allowed.

Electrical works: isolate, disconnect and make safe circuits before commencing; bury services/conduit in walls (uPVC surface-mounted trunking on solid concrete); test installations and leave works fully operational.
Gas Safe servicing programme: annual comprehensive service with LGSR report per dwelling; monthly electronic transfer of data to Client Gas Contract Team.
Gas safety inspection: internal gas supplies; all fitted gas appliances; appliance flues and terminals; ventilation arrangements.

Void gas safety inspection: gas meter fitted with meter blanking disc after tightness test; internal gas supplies capped/plugged off; appliances disconnected and capped/plugged; issue landlord's gas safety report.
Gas breakdowns: comprehensive 24-hour breakdown service for appliances in property schedule or as directed.

System boiler replacements: prepare and submit for approval prior to installation; verbal authorisation permitted for at-risk/priority situations; no property to be left without hot water for more than 24 hours; flush heating systems and install correct inhibiters.

Staff suitability: operatives must hold valid CSCS cards, appropriate trade qualifications, photo ID, and enhanced DBS checks (since clients may be vulnerable); trainees/apprentices always accompanied by fully qualified personnel.
Registration bodies: Gas Safe for gas work; Registered Competent Persons or Registered Third-Party Certifiers for electrical work.
Photo ID card must show photograph, employee name, trade (and 'Trainee' if applicable), contractor name and address, contact number, and expiry date (maximum 1 year from issue).
Competent supervisor on premises during works; site manager's instructions deemed given to the Contractor.
TUPE: staff of existing contractors transfer to successful contractor under TUPE 2006 Regulations; incumbent-supplied data is not vouched for by Bexley Council.
Environment & sustainability: promote recycling; reduce waste; use sustainable materials; lawful disposal of hazardous waste under EPA 1990; maintain spill kits on vehicles.
Quotation visits: contractor to visit addresses to estimate works free of charge prior to any approval.
Pricing: fully inclusive of all work including call out, site clearance and waste disposal; net and exclusive of VAT.

Warranties: 12 months for defects/breakdowns on repaired or installed equipment (excluding spare parts costs); rectify faults within 4 days of notification; 10+ default notices in 12 months may trigger contractor substitution; warranty cards completed on client's behalf.
Confidentiality: all client and contract matters treated as strictly confidential; full GDPR/Data Protection Act 2018 compliance.
Communication: maintain manned contact (answerphone not acceptable during normal hours); supervisors equipped with mobile phones; out-of-hours emergency number per specified timetable.

Performance review meetings to cover customer satisfaction, response-time compliance, financial monitoring, invoice queries, abortive calls, sites of concern, quality of work, equal opportunities, H&S, DBS declarations and randomised audits of contractor reports.

warnings.message: The tender specification does not explicitly cite CPV codes in its text. Lot-level CPV codes were inherited from the framework-level notice (50700000-2 Repair and maintenance services of building installations; 71315000-9 Building services) as the closest match to this Lot's residential maintenance scope. CPV codes provided on individual product_requirement_seeds (e.g., 50531200-8, 50711000-2, 71317100-4, 90923000-3, 90500000-2, 90650000-8, 50531100-7) are analyst-inferred from the cited standards and activities and are not directly quoted from the document.

Document does not contain explicit bid award criteria or price/quality weightings. The evaluation_criteria array captures the three contractual Key Performance Indicators (§20.2 KPIs) that govern ongoing performance monitoring — they are not award evaluation weights. Downstream consumers should treat them as performance criteria rather than tender scoring inputs.

This specification document covers only Lot 10 of Framework 6278 ('Planned, Preventative & Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services'). Existing notice-level lot rows (Lots 1-11) are documented in sibling specification documents and are not contradicted or merged here.

Document cites BS 7671 IET Wiring Regulations with inconsistent edition labels: §5.1 references 'BS 7671:200 Requirement for Electrical Installations - IET Wiring Regulations Seventeenth Edition' (likely typo for 'BS 7671:2008'), while §7.2 references the 'Eighteenth Edition'. Standard was consolidated as a single reference string with both citations recorded in technical_standards context.

Extraction source is Docling markdown without retained page boundaries (page_count = 0 reported). All evidence anchors use page_ref = 'full_document' with section_ref pointing to the numbered clause (e.g., §10.1). Downstream enrichment requiring true page numbers must re-run extraction with a page-preserving engine.
